limitations.bytes: Nonpersistent candidate/snapshot bytes are Python inputs, not a specified JSON byte-transport or semantic roundtrip protocol.
limitations.digest: Engineering file SHA256 is not RFC8785 child projection or parent/Bundle digest; F1 owns value_schema derivation.
limitations.numeric: JSON Schema mathematical integer/number do not enforce A strict Python int/float representation or all dynamic bounds.
limitations.relations: Finite reference/policy/Producer/history checks are separate from shape validation. Schemas do not prove expression typing, condition truth, model calls, runtime authority, external authenticity/history completeness or Release/Bundle admission.
limitations.taint: Constructed/copied-instance revalidation and deep immutability require Pydantic checks, not JSON Schema alone.
limitations.utc: Schema states normalized UTC lexical support; Pydantic checks calendar/aware semantics. No leap-second support; -00:00 provenance is not normalized away.
